name: Houtei Ren'ai ~Ai to Yokubou~
original_name: 法廷レンアイ～愛と欲望～
source:
"This love bite... it's proof that you're mine."
You work as a lawyer, but all you can dream of is losing yourself to a passionate and thrilling love...
After taking on a certain task, your life changes drastically...
A pompous lawyer from another company, an entrepreneur who's the cream of the crop, a mean and lewd senior lawyer...
Will you lose your sense of reason after they push you to the limit?!

[Translated from [url=http://www.andamul.com/special/houtei.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
“这爱的咬痕……证明你是我的。”
你是一名律师，但你所能梦想的却是迷失在一场热烈而惊心动魄的爱情中……
接受某项任务后，你的生活会发生巨大的变化……
浮夸的别家律师、百里挑一的企业家、卑鄙淫荡的资深律师……
当他们把你逼到极限后，你会失去理智吗？！

[翻译自[url=http://www.andamul.com/special/houtei.html]官网[/url]]
